edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource.

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 846.

note.en: Bai Juyi never shows the snow. He feels the cold first, then sees the window lit by it, and finally hears its weight breaking the bamboo outside. A whole snowfall reported by the senses of someone lying in bed, it is one of the quietest poems on this shelf.
note.zh: 白居易始终没有直接写雪。他先觉得冷，再看见窗户被雪映亮，最后听见积雪压断窗外竹子的声音。一场雪，全由一个躺在床上的人的感官来报告，这是这个书架上最安静的诗之一。

excerpt.orig: 夜深知雪重，時聞折竹聲。
excerpt.en: Deep in the night I know the snow is heavy: / now and then I hear the bamboo snap.
excerpt.zh: 夜深知雪重，时闻折竹声。

gloss.en: The window bright with the glow of snow outside.
The sound of bamboo snapping under the weight of snow.
